data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 frames its reduction from SRC_001 to SRC_002 as sound, then supplies a refutation condition (SRC_001 checks the mutation name as a string property independent of the typed-error contract) that is exactly what the target's own fixture description already establishes: SRC_001's eval checks the mutation name ('ignore-drift-field') while SRC_002 asserts a typed LEASE_MISMATCH. The target thus articulates a refutation of its own relation but never reconciles it — the relation is named as 'reduces to' yet the stated refutation condition is satisfied by the target's own endpoints, meaning the substantive relation is self-refuting rather than genuinely proposed.
